headline: Criticism of Arsene Wenger from Arsenal fans between 2009-2018 was fair?
body: Sir Alex has hit out at Arsenal fans for their criticism of Arsene Wenger in his later years. Personally I think it was fair, he literally went 9 years without a trophy and kept saying things like finishing 4th was as good as winning a trophy. Building the emirates didn’t cause him to get dumped out of the FA Cup by Blackburn, lose the carling cup final to Birmingham and so forth. That can’t happen at a club the size of Arsenal. Things got so bad that you’d have opposition fans singing “Arsene Wenger, we want you to stay”.   submitted by   /u/GMD3S1GNS [link]   [comments]
